snippet.title: Appulse - Release Date Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Appulse mixes roguelite action, top-down shooting and pinball. Every shot's recoil pushes your ball, so you steer with your guns as well as your flippers while defending the Vektor Dynamics fleet. It's inspired by the classic Space Cadet pinball. From Le Rado and Raw Fury.
